description: A binned facet value count produced by the ROUNDING post-processing algorithm. The exact count is obscured by reporting only the inclusive lower bound of the bin that contains it.

value.description: The value that is in the column

binMin.description: The inclusive lower bound of the bin that contains the exact count: floor(count / binSize) * binSize. The exact count lies within [binMin, binMin + binSize - 1].

isSelected.description: whether this facet was selected by the user
